LINE: headscale users |
  create	Create a local user
  delete	Delete a user with its keys
  get	Show one user
  list	List the users
  set	Change a local user
LINE: headscale users list --|
  --columns	Columns to show: a list, or +name and -name to change the default
  --config	Config file
  --filter	Keep the rows that match; may be repeated
  --help	Show this help
  --list-columns	List the columns, the API field behind each, and exit
  --output	Output format: json (the API object)
  --sort	Column to sort by; -name sorts in reverse
LINE: headscale users list --columns id,na|
  id,name
  id,name.
LINE: headscale users list --columns +lo|
  +login-name
LINE: headscale users list --sort -co|
  -count
LINE: headscale users list --filter=pro|
  --filter=profile-pic-url
  --filter=provider
  --filter=provider-id
LINE: headscale users set alice --|
  --config	Config file
  --display-name	New display name; "" clears it
  --email	New email address; "" clears it
  --help	Show this help
  --name	New username
  --output	Output format: json (the API object)
  --picture-url	New profile picture URL; "" clears it

  nodes	Manage nodes
LINE: headscale nodes |
  delete	Delete a node
  expire	Log a node out
  get	Show one node
  list	List the nodes
  routes	Manage the routes of a node
  set	Change the name or expiry of a node
  tags	Manage the tags of a node
  update-client	Ask a node to update its Tailscale client
LINE: headscale nodes routes ap|
  approve	Replace the enabled routes of a node
